title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical fashio
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical fashion lifestyle photograph of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with fair skin and a slender, naturally curvaceous figure, captured from an unusually high, downward-looking selfie perspective while standing outdoors beside a weathered concrete staircase and a red brick wall. Her ethnicity cannot be reliably determined from the visible portion of the photograph because her face is entirely outside the frame; preserve this ambiguity rather than inventing specific ethnic features.

The composition deliberately crops her head and most of her face above the upper-right edge, revealing only part of her neck, collarbones, upper chest, shoulders, torso, hips, and legs. Her eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, hairstyle, hair color, and facial expression are not visible and should remain outside the photograph rather than being artificially introduced. Her posture is relaxed and slightly angled, with her torso subtly twisting toward the downward-facing camera, one arm extending upward beyond the frame to hold the camera, and her other arm hanging naturally beside her hip.

She wears a fitted, thin, white ribbed sleeveless tank top with a deep, broad scoop neckline, narrow shoulder straps, and delicate white trim. The closely fitted fabric follows the natural contours of her full bust, slim waist, and gently curved abdomen, featuring realistic fabric tension, subtle wrinkles, and softly translucent-looking material under daylight without revealing explicit anatomical details. A delicate silver necklace with a small sparkling cross pendant rests at the center of her upper chest. A black-and-silver chain-like strap detail is visible near one shoulder.

Her lower outfit consists of faded dark indigo low-rise denim jeans, loosely fitted around the hips, with authentic worn denim texture, distressed fading, visible belt loops, copper rivets, and naturally creased seams. A narrow band of white underwear with a printed elastic waistband is visible above the jeans at her hip. A dark wristband encircles one wrist, and part of a white athletic sneaker appears near the concrete steps.

The environment features rough gray asphalt pavement, aged concrete stair edges, textured beige stone blocks, a small white planter containing dark soil, and reddish-brown brickwork in the upper background. Soft overcast daylight creates gentle shadows across her collarbones, clothing, and surroundings. Skin appears naturally fair with warm-neutral undertones, realistic pores, and subtle highlights. Emphasize authentic street-fashion photography, spontaneous handheld framing, slight wide-angle perspective distortion, natural fabric textures, realistic body proportions, restrained contrast, muted urban colors, soft cinematic tonal grading, and subtle photographic grain.

Shot on a modern smartphone camera using a 24mm-equivalent wide-angle lens, f/1.8, high-resolution realistic detail, natural depth of field, documentary-style candid atmosphere, portrait orientation, 9:16.
